    const state = {
      selectedPathway: localStorage.getItem('human_aftermath_pathway') || 'all',
      simScenarioId: 'workplace',
      simStage: 1,
      simHistory: {},
      view: 'arrival',
      currentModIdx: 0,
      currentLesIdx: 0,
      completedLessons: new Set(),
      reflections: {},
      learningMapNotes: {},
      theme: 'bone',
      fontSize: 'normal',
      reducedMotion: false
    };

    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('human_aftermath_state');
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (parsed.completedLessons) state.completedLessons = new Set(parsed.completedLessons);
        if (parsed.reflections) state.reflections = parsed.reflections;
        if (parsed.learningMapNotes) state.learningMapNotes = parsed.learningMapNotes;
        if (parsed.theme) state.theme = parsed.theme;
        if (parsed.fontSize) state.fontSize = parsed.fontSize;
      }
    } catch(e) {
      console.warn("localStorage unavailable, using in-memory state.");
    }

    function saveState() {
      try {
        const toSave = {
          completedLessons: Array.from(state.completedLessons),
          reflections: state.reflections,
          learningMapNotes: state.learningMapNotes,
          theme: state.theme,
          fontSize: state.fontSize
        };
        localStorage.setItem('human_aftermath_state', JSON.stringify(toSave));
      } catch(e) {}
      updateProgressUI();
    }

    function navigateTo(view, modIdx = state.currentModIdx, lesIdx = state.currentLesIdx) {
      state.view = view;
      state.currentModIdx = modIdx;
      state.currentLesIdx = lesIdx;
      
      const sb = document.getElementById('app-sidebar');
      if (sb && !sb.classList.contains('-translate-x-full') && window.innerWidth < 1024) {
        sb.classList.add('-translate-x-full');
      }

      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: state.reducedMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
      renderView();
      renderSidebar();
      updateProgressUI();
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function toggleSidebar() {
      const sb = document.getElementById('app-sidebar');
      if (sb) sb.classList.toggle('-translate-x-full');
    }

    function toggleModal(id) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) el.classList.toggle('hidden');
    }

    function updateProgressUI() {
      const total = courseData.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.lessons.length, 0);
      const done = state.completedLessons.size;
      const pct = Math.round((done / Math.max(total, 1)) * 100);
      
      const progEl = document.getElementById('top-nav-progress');
      if (progEl) progEl.innerText = pct + '%';
      
      const modEl = document.getElementById('top-nav-module-label');
      if (modEl) modEl.innerText = 'Module ' + (state.currentModIdx + 1);
      
      const lesEl = document.getElementById('top-nav-lesson-label');
      if (lesEl) {
        const currentLes = courseData[state.currentModIdx]?.lessons[state.currentLesIdx];
        lesEl.innerText = currentLes ? currentLes.title.replace(/^LESSON \d+:\s*/, '') : 'Arrival';
      }
    }

    function setFontSize(sz) {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('font-scale-lg', 'font-scale-xl');
      if (sz === 'large') document.documentElement.classList.add('font-scale-lg');
      if (sz === 'xlarge') document.documentElement.classList.add('font-scale-xl');
      state.fontSize = sz;
      saveState();
    }

    function setTheme(th) {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark', 'theme-stone');
      if (th === 'dark') document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
      if (th === 'stone') document.documentElement.classList.add('theme-stone');
      state.theme = th;
      saveState();
    }

    function toggleReducedMotion() {
      state.reducedMotion = document.getElementById('reduced-motion-toggle').checked;
      saveState();
    }

    function renderSidebar() {
      const container = document.getElementById('sidebar-module-tree');
      if (!container) return;

      let html = '';
      courseData.forEach((mod, mIdx) => {
        const isCurrentMod = state.view === 'lesson' && state.currentModIdx === mIdx;
        const modNum = mIdx + 1;
        const totalL = mod.lessons.length;
        const completedCount = mod.lessons.filter(l => state.completedLessons.has(l.id)).length;

        html += `
          <div class="border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 shadow-sm">
            <div class="p-3 bg-[#FAF6F7] dark:bg-stone-700/40 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:bg-stone-100 transition border-b border-stone-100 dark:border-stone-700" onclick="toggleModAccordion(${mIdx})">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#2C4A68] text-[#FFFFFF] flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0">${modNum}</span>
                <div class="text-xs font-bold truncate max-w-[170px] text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-100 font-serif-editorial">${mod.title}</div>
              </div>
              <span class="text-[10px] text-[#4A5C66] font-mono font-semibold shrink-0">${completedCount}/${totalL}</span>
            </div>
            <div id="sidebar-mod-content-${mIdx}" class="divide-y divide-stone-100 dark:divide-stone-700/50 text-xs ${isCurrentMod ? '' : 'hidden'}">
        `;

        mod.lessons.forEach((les, lIdx) => {
          const isCurrentLes = isCurrentMod && state.currentLesIdx === lIdx;
          const isDone = state.completedLessons.has(les.id);
          
          html += `
            <div class="p-2.5 pl-4 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-stone-700/30 cursor-pointer ${isCurrentLes ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-l-4 border-[#3e6892] font-semibold text-[#3e6892] dark:text-[#edae9d]' : 'text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300'}" onclick="navigateTo('lesson', ${mIdx}, ${lIdx})">
              <span class="truncate pr-2">${les.title.replace(/^LESSON \d+:\s*/, '')}</span>
              <span class="shrink-0 text-[#617B8A]">${isDone ? '<i data-lucide="check-circle" class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600"></i>' : '<i data-lucide="circle" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i>'}</span>
            </div>
          `;
        });

        const isCurrentReview = state.view === 'module_review' && state.currentModIdx === mIdx;
        html += `
          <div class="p-2.5 pl-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#16202A]/40 hover:bg-[#16202A] cursor-pointer ${isCurrentReview ? 'border-l-4 border-[#EDAE9D] font-bold text-[#EDAE9D]' : 'text-[#EDAE9D]/80'}" onclick="navigateTo('module_review', ${mIdx}, 0)">
            <span class="truncate pr-2 flex items-center gap-1.5"><i data-lucide="film" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i> Module ${modNum} Video Recap & Synthesis</span>
            <span class="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase bg-[#EDAE9D]/20 text-[#EDAE9D] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">Recap</span>
          </div>
        `;

        html += `
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      });

      container.innerHTML = html;
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function toggleModAccordion(mIdx) {
      const el = document.getElementById('sidebar-mod-content-' + mIdx);
      if (el) el.classList.toggle('hidden');

    function setPathway(pathwayId) {
      if (coursePathways[pathwayId]) {
        state.selectedPathway = pathwayId;
        localStorage.setItem('human_aftermath_pathway', pathwayId);
        renderView();
        renderSidebar();
        updateProgressUI();
        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
      }
    }

    function resumePathway() {
      const p = coursePathways[state.selectedPathway] || coursePathways.all;
      for (const mNum of p.modules) {
        const mIdx = mNum - 1;
        const mod = courseData[mIdx];
        if (mod) {
          for (let lIdx = 0; lIdx < mod.lessons.length; lIdx++) {
            const les = mod.lessons[lIdx];
            if (!state.completedLessons.has(les.id)) {
              navigateTo('lesson', mIdx, lIdx);
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      // If all completed in pathway, go to first module
      const firstModIdx = (p.modules[0] || 1) - 1;
      navigateTo('lesson', firstModIdx, 0);
    }
